lessons_used: 'adoption, redesign' changes have shown helpful, positive results after noise correction across 2 tests, backed by a winning test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, and 12 were underestimated.

candidates.title: pick_friend_spotlight_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen with a focused spotlight layout that highlights each pet's unique animations.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 68.4% conversion rate and earlier adoption redesign tests showed strong positive overall impact.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for pet selection screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have strong historical lift (+5.9%), supported by funnel drop-off at adoption step.

candidates.title: story_stage_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Transform the introductory story screen into a centered stage layout with prominent visual focus and clear call to action.
candidates.why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean duration of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation during early story presentation.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for story screen.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has high mean duration (514s), but conversion is relatively high (76.2%) and lacks support mail evidence.

candidates.title: new_pet_care_tips_screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet care tips screen at the end of onboarding detailing basic pet interactions and controls.
candidates.why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_pet_care_tips.headline: Pet Care Basics
new_pet_care_tips.body: Learn how to feed, play, and interact with your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new onboarding screen after home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off (64.8%) and clear support emails, but adding new screens at finish historically underperforms (-0.7%).

candidates.title: waiting_progress_checklist_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a checklist layout showing completed setup tasks while pet assets load.
candidates.why: The home step has a long mean duration of 2336s and median 201s during pet generation waiting period.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the waiting screen preserving its primary job.

candidates.score_note: Home step suffers from long waiting times (2336s mean), though support emails are not explicitly tied to layout redesign.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_recovery_note
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in syncs pet save files and prevents accidental reset.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main account to secure your pet data across app restarts.

guard.reason: Valid informational hint added to sign_in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence (8 tickets) addressing sign-in resets; low cost config/hint addition.

candidates.title: waiting_status_notify_option
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet initialization finishes.
candidates.why: Long wait times (mean 2336s) cause users to switch tasks and drop off before completing the onboarding funnel.

waiting.body: Your pet is being prepared. Enable notifications so we can alert you when it arrives!

guard.reason: Valid addition of notification option to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high idle time on home screen (2336s mean), but evidence relies mostly on funnel metrics.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_desktop_placement_tip
candidates.change: Add an informative tip on the adoption certificate screen explaining where on the desktop screen the pet will appear.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails noted issues where the pet does not show up on the desktop after onboarding.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your pet will wander near your desktop system tray upon completion.

guard.reason: Valid informative tip added to adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by support emails and targets adoption step drop-off (68.4% conversion) via cheap hint.

candidates.title: choose_path_starter_perks_notice
candidates.change: Add a starter accessory highlight badge on the path selection screen.
candidates.why: Encouraging early decision making helps reduce the high mean time (514s) spent on the path selection step.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions free extras.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_visibility_banner
candidates.change: Add a highlighted tip on the home intro screen showing how to toggle pet window visibility if obscured.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 tickets about pets not appearing on screen or being hidden behind active windows.

components.text: Tip: If your pet gets hidden under app windows, click the taskbar icon to bring it to front.

guard.reason: Valid tip component added to home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has major drop-off (64.8%) and multiple support tickets; low-cost notification banner.

candidates.title: upload_photos_compact_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload step into a clean, compact layout for faster image selection.
candidates.why: Support received tickets about custom pet creation errors, and adoption step efficiency is key to overall funnel conversion.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support tickets for custom pet creation and positive historical baseline for adoption redesigns (+5.9%).
